title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Off-by-one… (CVE-2026-80483)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain an off-by-one error vulnerability. This flaw could allow an unauthenticated local attacker to exploit the issue, potentially leading to session theft. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.3.
